conviction_note: Two offsetting findings: the 月次 put H1 sales ~4-6% above the July-revised H1 plan (public, so mostly priced), while the company's documented habit of raising only by the H1 excess and holding H2 (July revision kept implied H2 OP at 1,800; FY26 OP 2,800 never revised) points to a FY guide that still trails IFIS consensus ordinary profit of 5,100 against the company's 4,600; impact_sum +0.05, p_up 50, abs 1.6, so impact_scaled 0 and both measurements agree there is no edge.

findings.finding: The company's own 月次 for Jun-Aug 2026 show 4℃ (FDC) all-store sales +7.2/+15.4/+15.8%, GINZA RASIN +42.4/+37.5/+20.0% and Palette +(-7.4)/+19.2/+9.0% YoY, against a revised H1 plan whose implied Q2 sales (37,500 - 19,961 = 17,539m) are only +4.3% over last year's Q2 (16,815m); Brand Q2 is likely ~+20-27%, putting H1 sales ~39,000-39,800m, 4-6% above plan, with operating profit modestly above the 2,500m plan (Q2 implied 1,217m incl. an Asti retirement-benefit credit).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-07-10 Q1 beat with H1/FY raise: +3.23% next session (baseline; kabutan 2026-07-13 '４℃ホールデが反発'). 2025-10-10 H1 with forecast held: -1.21% (baseline, estimated date).
findings.why_not_priced: The 月次 are public, so the sales beat is largely held; what is not computable from them is the profit line (Rashin is low-margin, 4℃ raised prices mid-August on cost, and the Asti retirement credit size is undisclosed), so the H1 OP excess over 2,500m arrives only with the 短信. If fully priced the stock would have run up into the print; it is +0.14% over 5 days and +1.5% over 20.
findings.independence: Same series for July (https://cdn.clipkit.co/tenants/2641/item_files/assets/000/005/875/original/2607GS.pdf) and the July revision/Q1 短信 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260710/140120260710591237.pdf) for the plan arithmetic; last-year H1 segment numbers from https://cdn.clipkit.co/tenants/2641/item_files/assets/000/004/074/original/251010_76.2Q.tanshin.pdf. All company documents, one company source.

findings.finding: The FY forecast decision likely trails the street: IFIS consensus ordinary profit is 5,100m against the company's 4,600m, but the company's documented method is to raise only by the H1 excess and hold H2 (the July revision lifted FY OP by exactly the +700m H1 raise, leaving implied H2 OP at 1,800m; in FY26 it held OP 2,800m all year without revision and printed 2,802m), and September 月次 decelerated (4℃ all-store +5.2% with customers -2.7%, Rashin +18.9% vs +53-62% in Mar-Apr), giving it cover to hold H2 again.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: FY26 H1 (2025-10-10) forecast held: -1.21%; 2026-07-10 forecast raised: +3.23% (baseline estimated dates; kabutan news list confirms 2026-07-10 15:30 release).
findings.source_date: 2026-10-08 (page data stamp 財務データ：2026/10/08 更新)
findings.why_not_priced: The consensus 5,100m is the bar a holder carries; a raise that only adds the H1 excess (FY ordinary ~4,800-4,950m) would read as a raise in the headline but still undershoot it. The stock sits at 2,112 against a consensus TP of 2,200 and a neutral broker rating, so nobody is positioned for a large raise either, which is why this is sized small.
findings.independence: The method is read from the company's own revision notice (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260710/140120260710591219.pdf) and FY26 Q3 短信 showing no revision (https://cdn.clipkit.co/tenants/2641/item_files/assets/000/004/534/original/260109_76.3Q.tanshin.pdf); September deceleration from https://cdn.clipkit.co/tenants/2641/item_files/assets/000/006/437/original/2609GS.pdf. Three documents, different from the consensus source.

outside_window.finding: FY2027-02 is the final year of the 7th mid-term plan; a new plan and any move toward the stated long-run 100-yen dividend goal (DOE >= 4% target) would come with the full-year results around April 2027.

baseline_tension: Nothing here cuts against the baseline: run-up and positioning are flat (lean +0.05) and the two findings offset. The strongest positive the release could carry is a FY raise that clears IFIS 5,100m ordinary or a dividend increase toward the 100-yen goal; I looked for both, found the dividend explicitly held at 85 in July and the company's raise-by-H1-only habit, so neither is the base case but neither is excluded.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (negative resting on a public series toward 0/50): the guidance finding leans partly on the public September 月次, so it was trimmed from -0.6 to -0.45 and p_up moved from 49 to 50; the forecast decision itself is new at the release, so it was kept.
Rule 2 (check the sign): one positive and one negative; the strongest positive (FY raise above consensus, dividend change) was searched and is stated in baseline_tension. No further change.
